content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from alexisroyaleSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutedTagsalexisroyale•FollowKAROL G•LATINA FOREVAMore optionsalexisroyale 6dNot enough people are talking about Karol G’s performance, and it’s honestly upsetting. This was by far the best set at Coachella, and it deserved way more recognition. Her playlist was perfectly crafted, and the electrifying stage setup had me completely hooked. From start to finish, she held my full attention, and my best friend and I were in absolute awe the entire time. It genuinely felt like a Beyoncé-level performance, especially with the surprise guest appearances, the all-female mariachi band, and the incredible costume designs. Karol G truly delivered something unforgettable and proved exactly why she’s at the top of her game.
